revision: L: spring selection and loaded ride height
status: Engineering comparison; no spring or fabrication release
sensitivity_note: These are project sensitivity assumptions, not supplier tolerances. Each installed spring is calibrated with its module; settings are held fixed through contents/contact cases.
anti_tip_note: Conditional mount revision: raise the two front anti-tip roller allocations from Z=2..26 to Z=12..36 mm so they do not carry normal running loads at the new resting attitude. Brackets, tipping dynamics and threshold contact remain to design.
catalog_note: Use catalog load length L1 plus a project margin as a conservative operating-length screen. L1 is not a fatigue-life guarantee. Current SKU, tolerances and duty require supplier confirmation. Music-wire versions only; stainless rates differ.

candidates.note: Catalog solid height is more conservative than rounded product page; ID leaves inadequate clearance over the 6.5 mm guide.
Manufacturer web page rounds solid height to 0.52 inch; catalog gives 0.562 inch. Use the larger catalog figure until clarified.

contact_note: Imposed upward normal-force sensitivities, not measured or selected downforces. Sofa study covers stowed transit only; extended head/hose ground reactions and CG movement require a separate model. A prescribed contact point does not model cleaning-head compliance.
scope: Quasistatic flat floor, ideal three-point support, spherical tire reach, no friction, drive torque, acceleration or damping. K hardware masses retained; moving mass and wheel/hub centres resolved separately. I geometry used only for height checks. No flight conclusion.
